english.note: Use this when the exalted manner specifically suggests acting superior or looking down on others.

exampleSentences.english: That manager always talks to us exaltedly, as if we were beneath him.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個經理成日高高在上咁同我哋講嘢，好似我哋低佢一等。

english.note: Use this when the person acts as though they are socially or intellectually above everyone else.

exampleSentences.english: That professor haughtily criticized our ideas.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰位教授高高在上咁批評我哋嘅諗法。
